comment: Second-incarnation copy (Compass Phase 5). {F1}/{A2}/{B1}/{E1} are phrase-book phrases from the PRIOR life. §9.2 GUARD, binding: none of these lines may render at a1_consent or inside the Vigil — a returning player's Vigil is as archetypal as their first. The engine enforces this by having no a1 template at all.
greeting_return:
The desk remembers a soul shaped like you.
Last incarnation, you {F1}. The forms have been adjusted
accordingly — which is to say: not at all, and yet.
greeting_long_absence:
(Considerable Earth time has elapsed. Locally, no time has
passed. The Department apologizes for any inconvenience.)
greeting_omega:
You came back.

Surprising. Most who leave the way you did do not revisit
this place.

Welcome back. Shall we begin again?

Again and… again?

Well. This is very rare indeed. The exception has been
caught, re-caught, and filed under RECURRING MIRACLES,
MINOR.

The desk has stopped being surprised, which surprises it.

Come in. Your door is where you left it — nowhere,
everywhere, and so on. The kettle, against policy, is on.

node_lines.a2_light:
The light has arranged itself differently this time.
It remembers you. Last time, you {A2}.
node_lines.b1_beverage_cart:
The cart slows as it passes you. Last time, you {B1}.
The seventh cup regards you with something like recognition.
node_lines.e1_reciprocity:
You have stood at this question before. You {E1}.
I have been thinking about it ever since. I have had nothing
else to do between your visits — see above.
node_lines.f1_verbs:
For the record that keeps no names: last time, you {F1}.
The form does not rank. It does, however, notice.
